body.en:
A sector of a circle of radius \( 8 \text{ cm} \) has an angle of \( \theta = 1.25 \text{ radians} \) at the center. Calculate (a) the arc length, (b) the perimeter of the sector, and (c) the area of the minor segment formed by chord \( AB \).

Solution:
(a) Arc length: \( s = r\theta = 8 \times 1.25 = 10 \text{ cm} \).
(b) Perimeter: \( P = 2r + s = 2(8) + 10 = 26 \text{ cm} \).
(c) Segment Area: \( A_{\text{segment}} = \frac{1}{2}r^2(\theta - \sin\theta) = \frac{1}{2}(64)(1.25 - \sin(1.25 \text{ rad})) \).
Note: In radian mode, \( \sin(1.25) \approx 0.94898 \).
\( A = 32 \times (1.25 - 0.94898) = 32 \times 0.30102 \approx 9.63 \text{ cm}^2 \).
Answer: \( 9.63 \text{ cm}^2 \).

label.en: Worked Example 4.B — Solving Trig Equation via Identity

body.en:
Solve \( 2\sec^2 x - 3\tan x = 5 \) for \( 0^\circ \le x \le 360^\circ \).

Solution:
Replace \( \sec^2 x \) with \( 1 + \tan^2 x \):
\[ 2(1 + \tan^2 x) - 3\tan x - 5 = 0 \implies 2\tan^2 x - 3\tan x - 3 = 0 \]
Solve for \( \tan x \) using the quadratic formula:
\[ \tan x = \frac{3 \pm \sqrt{9 - 4(2)(-3)}}{4} = \frac{3 \pm \sqrt{33}}{4} \]
1. \( \tan x = \frac{3 + \sqrt{33}}{4} \approx 2.186 \implies x = 65.4^\circ \) and \( x = 180^\circ + 65.4^\circ = 245.4^\circ \).
2. \( \tan x = \frac{3 - \sqrt{33}}{4} \approx -0.686 \implies \text{basic angle } \alpha = \tan^{-1}(0.686) \approx 34.5^\circ \).
In Q2 and Q4: \( x = 180^\circ - 34.5^\circ = 145.5^\circ \) and \( x = 360^\circ - 34.5^\circ = 325.5^\circ \).
Answer: \( x = 65.4^\circ, 145.5^\circ, 245.4^\circ, 325.5^\circ \).

label.en: Worked Example C — Algebraic Structure & Vieta's Root Relations
label.ar: مثال محلول C — البنية الجبرية وعلاقات الجذور

body.en:
Solve the quadratic equation \( x^2 - 13x + 36 = 0 \) and verify the sum and product of its roots.

Step-by-step Solution:
  1. Factor into binomials: \( (x - 4)(x - 9) = 0 \implies x = 4 \text{ or } x = 9 \).
  2. Check Vieta's formulas: sum \( = 4 + 9 = \mathbf{13} \) and product \( = (4)(9) = \mathbf{36} \).
body.ar:
حل المعادلة التربيعية \( x^2 - 13x + 36 = 0 \) وتحقق من مجموع وحاصل ضرب الجذرين.

الحل بالتفصيل:
  1. التحليل إلى عوامل: \( (x - 4)(x - 9) = 0 \implies x = 4 \text{ أو } x = 9 \).
  2. المجموع \( = \mathbf{13} \) وحاصل الضرب \( = \mathbf{36} \).

label.en: Worked Example D — Algebraic Structure & Vieta's Root Relations

body.en:
Solve the quadratic equation \( x^2 - 10x + 25 = 0 \) and verify the sum and product of its roots.

Step-by-step Solution:
  1. Factor into binomials: \( (x - 5)(x - 5) = 0 \implies x = 5 \text{ or } x = 5 \).
  2. Check Vieta's formulas: sum \( = 5 + 5 = \mathbf{10} \) and product \( = (5)(5) = \mathbf{25} \).
body.ar:
حل المعادلة التربيعية \( x^2 - 10x + 25 = 0 \) وتحقق من مجموع وحاصل ضرب الجذرين.

الحل بالتفصيل:
  1. التحليل إلى عوامل: \( (x - 5)(x - 5) = 0 \implies x = 5 \text{ أو } x = 5 \).
  2. المجموع \( = \mathbf{10} \) وحاصل الضرب \( = \mathbf{25} \).

question.en: [Trigonometry & Circular Measure · Practice 1] If the governing relation for this system is \( g(t) = 3t + 3 \), evaluate \( g(4) \) and find the inverse input \( t \) when \( g(t) = 18 \).
question.ar: [Trigonometry & Circular Measure · تدريب 1] إذا كانت العلاقة الحاكمة هي \( g(t) = 3t + 3 \)، فأوجد \( g(4) \) وكذلك قيمة \( t \) عندما \( g(t) = 18 \).

solution.en: Substitute \( t = 4 \): \( g(4) = 3(4) + 3 = \mathbf{15} \). Setting \( 3t + 3 = 18 \) gives \( 3t = 15 \implies t = \mathbf{5} \).
solution.ar: بالتعويض عن \( t = 4 \): \( g(4) = 3(4) + 3 = \mathbf{15} \). وعندما \( 3t + 3 = 18 \) فإن \( t = \mathbf{5} \).

question.en: [Trigonometry & Circular Measure · Practice 2] If the governing relation for this system is \( g(t) = 4t + 4 \), evaluate \( g(6) \) and find the inverse input \( t \) when \( g(t) = 32 \).
question.ar: [Trigonometry & Circular Measure · تدريب 2] إذا كانت العلاقة الحاكمة هي \( g(t) = 4t + 4 \)، فأوجد \( g(6) \) وكذلك قيمة \( t \) عندما \( g(t) = 32 \).

solution.en: Substitute \( t = 6 \): \( g(6) = 4(6) + 4 = \mathbf{28} \). Setting \( 4t + 4 = 32 \) gives \( 4t = 28 \implies t = \mathbf{7} \).
solution.ar: بالتعويض عن \( t = 6 \): \( g(6) = 4(6) + 4 = \mathbf{28} \). وعندما \( 4t + 4 = 32 \) فإن \( t = \mathbf{7} \).

question.en: [Trigonometry & Circular Measure · Practice 4] If the governing relation for this system is \( g(t) = 6t + 6 \), evaluate \( g(10) \) and find the inverse input \( t \) when \( g(t) = 72 \).
